title: [endoflife.ai] KEV-Exposed Product at Elevated EOL Risk
description: Alerts when a product you run (detected on your hosts by the stack scan or listed in EOL_PRODUCTS; tag detected:true) carries active CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities exposure and an EOL Risk Score of 60 or more. Exploited plus end-of-life means the fix for the next exploited CVE may never arrive - the most urgent combination this integration tracks. Catalog-only products never alert. Powered by endoflife.ai - https://endoflife.ai/exploited-and-unpatchable
